# Raw repository content

## URL contract

- **Route ID:** `page-owner-repository-raw-refandpath`
- **Support path:** `/{owner}/{repository}/raw/{*refAndPath}`
- **GitHub canonical patterns:** `https://github.com/{owner}/{repository}/raw/{*refAndPath}`
- **Delivery:** `page`
- **Status:** `excluded`
- **Materialization:** `scaffolded`

## Functional intent

Reserve the GitHub-style raw content route without introducing Git content behavior.

The filesystem route is reserved and currently returns the canonical unavailable response.
